validated_results.title: Vitamin D and prostate cancer.
validated_results.journal: The Journal of steroid biochemistry and molecular biology
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative overview summarizing the authors' previously published nested case-control findings together with lighting-intervention and rat/cell-line mechanistic work, rather than an original primary epidemiological analysis of vitamin D and incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Vitamin D receptor gene polymorphisms, insulin-like growth factors, and prostate cancer risk: a population-based case-control study in China.
validated_results.reason: The analysis reports VDR gene polymorphisms and FokI genotype-stratified IGFBP effects on prostate cancer risk rather than any population-wide vitamin D exposure estimate.
